title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 57 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 57 - Capital Gains Profits and gains arising from transfer of ownership of capital assets shall be capital income: Provided that any notional gain or profit arising out of any asset which has not actually been transferred by following the fair market value method as per International Accounting Standards (IAS) or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) shall not be treated as capital income.
